verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an API product, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question. The evidence only shows that plain API keys are free to create, that no OAuth is needed, and that agents can use the MCP server or MPP without a key. Nothing documents per-key scopes, permission limits or least-privilege credentials for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
